Behind the stitches

Hi, I'm Julia!

I'm the maker behind Jules Handmade. I love turning creative ideas into pieces you can use, gift, and keep. Every order gives me a chance to try something new and add personal details that make it feel one of a kind.

Thanks for supporting my little handmade business. It means so much!
